---
applyTo: "src/i18n/**/*.ts,src/**/*.vue"
---

- No visible text in `.vue` files or composables: it comes from `src/i18n/messages/`. Views read it with `useLocale()`; components receive it as props; code outside components uses `currentMessages()`.
- A new key goes into the `Messages` interface (`src/i18n/messages/types.ts`) and into all six files (`en.ts`, `pt-br.ts`, `pt.ts`, `fr.ts`, `it.ts`, `de.ts`) in the same change, written for each language (Brazilian and European Portuguese differ).
- API wire values (`Branco`, `Rei`, `/propoe`, `lado`) are never translated in code or sent translated; their display names are in the `labels` section.
